news.headline: Kenneth Walker III, Patrick Mahomes lead Chiefs' win vs. Broncos
news.description: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes, making his return from a torn ACL, and running back Kenneth Walker III, making his Chiefs debut, powered Kansas City to a season-opening blowout win over Denver.

news.headline: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey day-to-day with rib injury
news.description: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that wide receiver Ladd McConkey has a rib injury and is considered day-to-day.

news.headline: Giants' Harbaugh admits tackling Nabers to relax WR's injury fears
news.description: Giants coach John Harbaugh says tackling star receiver Malik Nabers was "all in fun" and was an effort to help the wideout move beyond his injury fears.

news.headline: Inside Patrick Mahomes' remarkable return from knee injury
news.description: On Dec. 14, Mahomes, after suffering the most significant injury of his career, vowed to be back for Week 1. Here's how he did it.

news.headline: Mahomes on first TD in injury return: 'Wasn't planning on using my legs that early'

news.headline: Seahawks say Sam Darnold has 'unique soft-tissue' injury
news.description: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold is dealing with what the team described as a "very unique soft-tissue" injury that is not expected to sideline him long term.

news.headline: Ravens' Flowers day-to-day, Lane to be out longer, Minter says
news.description: Ravens receiver Zay Flowers is considered day-to-day while receiver Ja'Kobi Lane could be out for a longer period with a wrist injury, coach Jesse Minter said.

news.headline: Vikings' O'Connell doesn't fault Packers for hit on QB Murray
news.description: The hit that caused Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray's concussion was a "violent, physical play" but was not objectionable, coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday.

news.headline: Chiefs' Travis Kelce now No. 2 among TEs in receiving yards
